data.code_commit_message:
feat(cpu): add stack operations (PUSH/POP/SPRD/SPWR) and ADDI instruction

Implement SP register (reset 0xFFCF) with full pipeline support:
- PUSH (pre-dec SP, write), POP (read, post-inc SP)
- SPRD (read SP to GPR), SPWR (write GPR to SP)
- ADDI Rd, Imm8 (signed immediate add)
- SP forwarding chain for zero-stall back-to-back stack ops
- Zero-gap hazard detection for ADDI/PUSH/SPWR

Also fixes two pre-existing forwarding bugs:
- SIM-BUG-20: forwarding matched rega_sel without checking reg_ctl != regNOP
  (fixes test_sort, previously known_fail)
- SIM-BUG-21: ADDI R-type func decode override (imm bits misread as func code)
